external_coverage.exact_statement: Berman–Darvas–Lu, published Proposition 4.4: on a connected compact Kähler (X,ω), each smooth closed real (1,1)-form γ defines AMγ(v)=(nV)^−1 Σ_{k=0}^{n−1}∫vγ∧ω_v^k∧ω^{n−1−k}, where ω_v=ω+i∂∂̄v and V=∫ω^n. Its decreasing extension to E1 is real-valued, d1-continuous, equal to the nonpluripolar-product formula, and bounded on d1-bounded sets.
Berman–Darvas–Lu, published Proposition 4.5: on a connected compact Kähler manifold, AMγ is convex along bounded-Laplacian weak geodesic segments for every smooth closed real (1,1)-form γ≥0.

Berman–Darvas–Lu, published Theorem 4.7, χ=0 and p=1: on a connected compact Kähler (X,ω), with ω_v=ω+i∂∂̄v, RicBDL=−i∂∂̄logω^n and SBDL=nV^−1∫RicBDL∧ω^{n−1}, K(v)=Ent(ω_v^n/V|ω^n/V)+SBDL AM(v)−n AM_RicBDL(v) is the greatest d1-lower-semicontinuous extension from smooth Kähler potentials to E1 and is convex along finite-energy E1 geodesics.

Darvas–Zhang, arXiv:2509.15173v2, Theorem 10.1: for a polarized smooth manifold (X,L) with ω∈c1(L), every finite-energy geodesic ray from 0 with finite radial entropy admits smooth test configurations dominating X×P1 and rational β_k>1 tending to infinity such that the zero-start rays of their log-discrepancy models, with classes L^(k)+β_k^−1 Klog_{X^(k)/(X×P1)}, converge to the given ray in chordal d1 distance and their radial entropies converge to its radial entropy.

Darvas–Xia–Zhang, arXiv:2302.02541v3, Section 2.1: on a connected compact Kähler manifold with a smooth closed real big form θ, for genuine u,v∈PSH(X,θ), Pθ[u](v)=(lim_{C→∞}Pθ(u+C,v))*; the absolute envelope uses v=Vθ. The I-envelope is Pθ[u]I(v)=sup{z∈PSH(X,θ): z≤v, I(tz)⊆I(tu) for every t≥0}, where I(tu) is locally generated by holomorphic f for which |f|²e^−tu is integrable.

harmless_mathematical_wording_correction: The original nonmaximal ray, rather than its maximalization, has positive energy defect relative to its maximalization; equations15-16 unchanged.
other_changes: Final title/author identify scoped checked theorem; appendix replaces artifact-local reproduction instructions with accurate preserved-author-record provenance. Abstract status corrected from unreviewed draft to independently checked in exactly granted scope.
accepted_scope: General compact Kahler, fixed actual w in E1 with finite initial entropy; joint index/time maximal-ray entropy recovery in finite branch assuming NA entropy convergence, infinite-branch joint divergence without approximant entropy-limit assumption; joint contracted energies and actual relatively Kahler model corollary.
